# Codex Smith

> A self-hosted Telegram control plane for local OpenAI Codex agents.

## Summary

Codex Smith connects Telegram to a local Codex installation. The official Codex SDK
is the primary backend, with `codex exec` and CLI/PTy fallbacks. It persists threads
per chat and repository, streams agent events, switches projects below an allowlisted
workspace root, and provides explicit GitHub and MCP operations.

## Security Model

- Telegram user allowlist is mandatory
- Default Codex sandbox is `workspace-write`
- Default approval policy is `on-request`
- Codex network access and the bot shell are disabled by default
- One active bot-managed writer is allowed per working directory
- Credentials and runtime state are excluded from version control

## Stack

TypeScript, Node.js 20+, `@openai/codex-sdk`, Telegraf, node-pty, node-cron, MCP SDK.
